=== ROOT CancerOS breast cancer digital twin ===
 Research-only, time-indexed, provenance-aware breast cancer imaging, simulation and interpretation prototype. NOT validated clinical decision support.

Sources: DATA,API

  <-- RELATES_TO DATA.BRANCH SimulationBranch

=== SIM.OBS Observation simulation ===
 Timestamped labs, vitals, symptoms, imaging geometry, notes, irregular sampling and missingness. 
Sources: SIM,DATA

  <-- HAS_STEP WF.SIM Synthetic scenario vertical slice
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES SIM.LATENT Latent evolution state

=== SIM.VALID Simulation validation ===
 Reject structural, temporal, unit, cross-modal, geometry, provenance and unsafe interpretation failures. 
Sources: SIM,DATA
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.SIM Synthetic longitudinal engine
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.SIM Synthetic scenario vertical slice
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES IMG.SYNMESH Synthetic lesion geometry
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES TWIN.BRANCH Scenario branch isolation

  <-- VERIFIES EVAL.SIM Simulation integrity evaluation

=== EVAL.SIM Simulation integrity evaluation ===
 Plausibility review, parameter assumptions, correlations, chronology, reproducibility and missingness. 
Sources: TEST
  <-- TESTS D.EVAL Scientific evaluation
  --> VERIFIES SIM.VALID Simulation validation

=== X.GENOME Whole-genome/cell-scale simulation ===
 Explicitly outside the hackathon prototype scope. 
Sources: PRD
